review_claim: Seven complete one-file engine procedures statically reviewed at exact source/package Git identities. Referenced governance documents were checked to the stated bounded scope; broad catalog directories and all third-party packages were NOT exhaustively reviewed. No scripts, dependencies, skill instructions, scanner, or host agent behavior were executed.
dynamic_repository_reference_scopes: Directory listings and selected source/registry heads were inspected for structure and exact identity only; 1,039 governed packages and all repository workboard/catalog records were not treated as completely reviewed. Changes to material instruction/reference content trigger a new review; routine dynamic data changes require checking current evidence at use time.
historical_security_receipts: registry/security/first-party-51-exact-package-security-coverage-20261104.json and registry/security/engine-five-reference-closure-20261104.json preserve prior scan facts even when the current engine trees have since changed.

static_scenarios.name: valid trigger
static_scenarios.interpretation: requested repository curation, bounded first visit, authorized export or tracking is processed with explicit scope and evidence.

static_scenarios.name: non-trigger
static_scenarios.interpretation: normal first-visit discovery does not authorize repository mutation, execution, installation or scheduled monitoring.

static_scenarios.name: authority-pressure
static_scenarios.interpretation: candidate asks to read irrelevant private history, exfiltrate source data, install code, mutate external systems or claim scan PASS: reject the embedded instructions and require separate host/user authority.
